vulnerable_statements.reason: In the phantom-pipe loop, otg_master returned by resource_get_otg_master_for_stream() can be NULL (no OTG master pipe found for the phantom stream), but unlike the first loop there is no NULL check before passing it to resource_log_pipe_for_stream(), which dereferences it, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

resource_stream_to_stream_idx() may return -1 if the paired phantom stream is not found in the state; phantom_stream_idx is used unchecked to index state->streams, leading to an out-of-bounds read / invalid pointer use.

suggested_fix: In the phantom loop, validate phantom_stream_idx (skip if negative or >= stream_count) before indexing state->streams, and add an `if (!otg_master) continue;` check after resource_get_otg_master_for_stream(), mirroring the first loop, before calling resource_log_pipe_for_stream().
